# Audience-True Verification

Success means the right consumers see the right state—not merely that a local command exited zero.

## Destination checks

Confirm artifacts land where downstream processes expect them and are readable in context.

## Semantic equality

For replacements and migrations, verify functional equivalence under the workflow that uses them, not only syntactic similarity.

## Feedback loops

When humans are in the loop, ensure notifications or handoffs carry accurate minimal context.
